final: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) as analysis_count, CAST(COUNT(ab.abhvreg) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior ab2 JOIN transactionrecord tr2 ON ab2.translink = tr2.transreg JOIN trader t2 ON tr2.trdref = t2.tradereg) as proportion FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind ORDER BY t.tradekind
